system_overview: This specification contains machine-checked formal proofs of the safety properties of Dijkstra's ring-based termination detection algorithm (EWD840). The proofs are verified using the TLA+ Proof System (TLAPS) and establish both type correctness and the main soundness property: termination is detected only when all nodes are indeed inactive.
actors_and_components: The system is the same ring of N nodes with a circulating token as defined in the base EWD840 specification. This module focuses on proving properties about that system rather than defining new behavior.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from the base EWD840 specification: node activation status, node colors, token position, and token color.
initial_state: The initial state is inherited from the base EWD840 specification.
actions: All actions are inherited from the base EWD840 specification: initiate probe, pass token, send message, and deactivate.
safety_properties: Two properties are formally proved: (1) Type correctness: the type invariant is inductive, meaning it is preserved by every possible transition from any reachable state. (2) Safety (termination detection correctness): the specification implies that whenever termination is detected (white token at node 0, node 0 white and inactive), all nodes are indeed inactive. The proof shows that Dijkstra's inductive invariant implies the termination detection property, with a detailed hierarchical sub-proof of this implication.
additional_assumptions: Requires TLAPS (TLA+ Proof System) to be installed for proof checking. The proofs use multiple TLAPS backend provers and the PTL (propositional temporal logic) proof method for temporal reasoning.
